summary: Cred analyzes monthly closes in BTC and ETH to determine if bears are dead. BTC closed at resistance around 13.8k, suggesting structure remains intact with potential to move toward support at 11.6k. He's skeptical of rallies and sees 15k-16k as potential high time frame wick targets if resistance fails. Ethereum looks worse with a failed breakout at 390-400 and a bearish monthly close signaling a retest of support at 290-300. Overall, he doesn't believe bears are dead and expects range-bound consolidation.
